name: 922 Pallet Stamper
description: Stamp work-packet PDFs with PO batch number and pallet assignments. Failed stamps (e.g. OneDrive cloud errors) are retried after the main pass; anything still unstamped is listed with its pallet in a popup for manual stamping.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder. The batch's order folders should each hold their work-packet PDF.
The 'PO H{n} Pallet & Rod Organizer.xlsx' must be in the batch's Documentation folder - the pallet numbers come from its Pallet Organizer sheet.
Close the work-packet PDFs if they're open in a viewer, so they can be re-saved with the stamp.
how_it_works: Pick the batch's own 'Batch NNN' folder when the picker opens - no batch number typing. The app reads which order goes on which pallet from the organizer.
For each order folder it stamps the work-packet PDF's first page with 'Batch {n} Pallet {n}' in red, replacing any old stamp.

Drawing binders are left alone. The work packet is identified by READING page 1 - a part drawing carries the ASA title block, a work packet never does - so a binder sitting in the order folder is never stamped by mistake. A stray stamp an older version left on a drawing is taken back off.
output: Each order's work-packet PDF stamped with its batch and pallet, and a summary of what was stamped, skipped, or needs a hand-stamp.
